import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)

    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\nSheet: {name}, dims: {ws.dimensions}, max_row: {ws.max_row}, max_col: {ws.max_column}")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 8)):
        print([(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row])

import subprocess

code = r'''
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook("sales_data.xlsx")
ws = wb["Sales Data"]
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
for coord in ["A1","E1","G1","A2","E2","G2","C10","E10","G10"]:
    c = ws[coord]
    print(coord, "| font:", c.font.name, c.font.size, "bold:", c.font.bold, "color:", c.font.color.rgb if c.font.color else None,
          "| fill:", c.fill.fgColor.rgb if c.fill and c.fill.patternType else None,
          "| numfmt:", repr(c.number_format),
          "| border L/R/T/B:", c.border.left.style, c.border.right.style, c.border.top.style, c.border.bottom.style,
          "| align:", c.alignment.horizontal, c.alignment.vertical)
for col in range(1, 8):
    letter = get_column_letter(col)
    print(letter, "width:", ws.column_dimensions[letter].width)
'''

r = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/python3", "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
